description: This is a Java source file defining the EntryListFragment class, which manages a list of feed entries via a CursorLoader, interfaces with a content provider, handles sync status updates, and provides UI interactions including refresh and item clicks.

classes.name: EntryListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that displays a list of entries from a content provider, manages data loading with loaders, observes sync status, and handles user interactions such as refresh and item selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and indicates that it has an options menu.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Creates a sync account through SyncUtils if it does not already exist.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the cursor adapter, binds it to the ListView, and initializes the loader.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the sync status observer to listen for sync state changes.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns a CursorLoader to query the feed entries ordered by publication date.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps the new cursor into the adapter, updating the list view.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the cursor from the adapter to free resources.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu which includes the refresh button.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles refresh button clicks to trigger a sync refresh.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Opens the selected article URL in the default browser.

methods.name: setRefreshActionButtonState
methods.description: Updates the refresh menu item to show or hide an indeterminate progress indicator.

methods.name: mSyncStatusObserver
methods.description: Callback object that responds to sync status changes and updates the UI accordingly.
